name: TOKYO KEIKI INC.
summary: TOKYO KEIKI INC., together with its subsidiaries, manufactures and sells marine and port, hydraulic and pneumatic, fluid, defence and communication, inspection, and railway equipment in Japan, Europe, Asia, the United States, and internationally. The company offers marine systems, including gyrocompass, fibre optic gyrocompass, autopilot systems, ECDIS, speed log, magnetic compass, straight leg course control unit, digital course recorder, and bridge navigation watch alarm system; fluid power systems, such as direct drive system, vane pumps, piston pumps, vane motors, COMNICA valve, digital valve, manifold block, power package, and switches and sensors.
